info.title: Axgit API
info.description:
Read-only JSON API over bare Git repositories, plus Smart HTTP (fetch/clone) and an Atom feed.

There are no mutation endpoints and no authentication: writes happen over SSH on the git-server container, never here.

This document describes shapes, parameters and status codes. The semantic rules it cannot express — truncation caps, longest-ref matching for the `{ref}`/`{path}` split, merge-commit log simplification, and the exact conditions under which a field is `null` — live in `docs/API.md`, which remains the normative contract.

get.description:
Served from the scan snapshot ([`crate::cache::ScanCache`]), not the
response cache — the list has no single backing repository, so its `ETag`
is a hash of the serialized body.

200.description: Repository list

Cache-Control.description: `no-cache`

ETag.description: Hash of the response body; opaque

500.description: Repository root could not be scanned

get.description:
An empty repository (unborn HEAD) still answers `200`, with `head`,
`default_branch` and `last_modified` `null` and both counts 0.

200.description: Repository summary

Cache-Control.description: `no-cache`

get.description:
Streams `git archive` output chunked (no `Content-Length`). The ref is
resolved first and only the **full sha** reaches the command line. The
`{ref}.{format}` split is suffix matching: `.tar.gz` first, then `.zip`.

200.description: Archive stream (`application/gzip` or `application/zip`). If `git archive` fails mid-stream the response is truncated without a status change.

Cache-Control.description: `no-cache`, or `public, max-age=31536000, immutable` for a full sha

304.description: `If-None-Match` matched — no git process is spawned

get.description:
`{ref}`/`{path}` split as for the tree endpoint. Rename tracking is not
performed — only moves within the file are attributed, per libgit2
defaults.

200.description: Line ranges covering the whole file. Immutable caching only when `{ref}` is the resolved full sha (then no `ETag`).

Cache-Control.description: `no-cache`, or `public, max-age=31536000, immutable` for a full sha

get.description:
`{ref}`/`{path}` split as for the tree endpoint. Binary or over-1 MiB files
report `content: null` — fetch the raw endpoint instead.

200.description: Blob metadata and inline content. Immutable caching only when `{ref}` is the resolved full sha (then no `ETag`).

Cache-Control.description: `no-cache`, or `public, max-age=31536000, immutable` for a full sha

get.description:
Cursor-paginated, newest first. Merge commits survive the `path` filter
only when the path differs from **every** parent — an approximation of
`git log -- <path>` simplification.

parameters.name: ref
parameters.description: Branch, tag, or commit sha; HEAD when absent. Ignored when `cursor` is set.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description:
Only commits that changed this file or directory. A path that never
existed yields an empty list rather than a 404.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description:
`next_cursor` from a previous page. Opaque: a malformed or unknown
value is `400 invalid_param`, not a 404.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description:
Parsed manually so an invalid value yields the JSON `invalid_param`
envelope instead of axum's plain-text 400. Never clamped.

200.description: One page of commits. An empty repository with no `ref` yields an empty page.

Cache-Control.description: `no-cache`

get.description:
Superset of a log entry, plus the full message and the first-parent
diffstat. The diffstat has no file cap.

200.description: Commit detail. Immutable caching only when `{sha}` is the resolved full sha (then no `ETag`).

Cache-Control.description: `no-cache`, or `public, max-age=31536000, immutable` for a full sha

get.description:
Unified diff as JSON (file → hunk → line), against the first parent.
Caps: 1000 rendered lines per file (whole hunks are dropped, never cut) and
300 files per response; `additions`/`deletions` stay complete either way.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description:
Restrict the diff to one file (literal match, no globbing). A path that
this commit did not touch yields `files: []`, not a 404.

parameters.name: context
parameters.description:
Context lines around each change. Parsed manually so an invalid value
yields the JSON `invalid_param` envelope instead of axum's plain-text
400. Never clamped.

parameters.name: ignorews
parameters.description:
Ignore whitespace-only changes (`git diff --ignore-all-space`). Line
`content` is unaffected — only which lines/hunks are shown changes.

200.description: Structured diff. Immutable caching only when `{sha}` is the resolved full sha (then no `ETag`).

Cache-Control.description: `no-cache`, or `public, max-age=31536000, immutable` for a full sha

get.description:
Arbitrary two-revision diff (`git diff <from> <to>`), the same structured
shape as the per-commit diff plus an uncapped `diffstat`. `?to=X` alone
(no `from`) produces `files` identical to `GET /commits/X/diff`. `from`
and `to` accept anything `resolve_commit` does — branch, tag, sha, or a
`revparse_single` expression such as `main~1`.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description:
Old side of the comparison (`git diff <from> <to>` — not a merge-base
`...` diff). Defaults to `to`'s first parent (the empty tree for a
root commit).

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: New side of the comparison. Defaults to `HEAD`.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description:
Restrict the diff to one file (literal match, no globbing). A path
neither side touched yields `files: []`, not a 404.

parameters.name: context
parameters.description:
Context lines around each change. Parsed manually so an invalid value
yields the JSON `invalid_param` envelope instead of axum's plain-text
400. Never clamped.

200.description: Two-revision diff. Immutable caching only when every side given resolves to the exact requested string as a full sha.

Cache-Control.description: `no-cache`, or `public, max-age=31536000, immutable`

get.description:
The 20 most recent commits on HEAD. Absolute URLs are reconstructed from
`X-Forwarded-Proto`/`X-Forwarded-Host`, falling back to `Host`; entry ids
are `urn:sha1:{sha}` so they stay stable across hosts. An empty repository
returns `200` with no entries.

200.description: Atom 1.0 feed

Cache-Control.description: `no-cache`

get.description:
`git format-patch`-style mbox series for the commit range `(from, to]` —
`from` **excluded**, the opposite convention from `/diff`/`/rawdiff`.
Every commit is diffed against its own first parent, including merges
(`git format-patch` itself skips merges; every other axgit diff is
first-parent, so this endpoint stays consistent with those instead).
Rejects (`400`) rather than truncates a range over
[`crate::repo::diff::MAX_PATCH_COMMITS`] commits. For `git am`.

Includes the author's name and email in `From:` headers — required for
`git am` to preserve authorship, and the one axgit response that exposes a
plain email address (docs/DECISIONS.md #38). Marked `noindex, nofollow`.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description:
Start of the commit range, **excluded** (`git format-patch
<from>..<to>`) — unlike `from` on `/diff`/`/rawdiff`, which names the
other side of a tree comparison. Omitted renders a single patch for
`to` alone.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End of the range (inclusive). Defaults to `HEAD`.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Restrict every commit's diff to one file (literal match, no globbing).

200.description: mbox-format patch series, no size limit. Immutable caching only when every side given resolves to the exact requested string as a full sha.

Cache-Control.description: `no-cache`, or `public, max-age=31536000, immutable`

400.description: `invalid_param` — commit range exceeds the patch-count limit

get.description:
No size cap. Not routed through the response cache — raw bodies are
unbounded binaries that would crowd out the JSON entries. Non-sha requests
still carry an `ETag` so a 304 saves the transfer (the bytes are re-read
either way). `{ref}`/`{path}` split as for the tree endpoint.

200.description: File bytes. `Content-Type` is guessed from the extension, falling back to `text/plain; charset=utf-8` or `application/octet-stream`.

Cache-Control.description: `no-cache`, or `public, max-age=31536000, immutable` for a full sha

get.description:
Plain unified diff between two revisions (`git diff <from> <to>`, the same
two-dot semantics as `GET /diff` — not a merge-base `...` diff), for
`git apply`. **No line/file caps** — unlike the structured diffs, a
truncated patch would be a corrupt one.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description:
Old side of the comparison (`git diff <from> <to>` — not a merge-base
`...` diff). Defaults to `to`'s first parent (the empty tree for a
root commit).

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: New side of the comparison. Defaults to `HEAD`.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description:
Restrict the diff to one file (literal match, no globbing). A path
neither side touched yields `files: []`, not a 404.

parameters.name: context
parameters.description:
Context lines around each change. Parsed manually so an invalid value
yields the JSON `invalid_param` envelope instead of axum's plain-text
400. Never clamped.

200.description: Plain unified diff, no size limit. Immutable caching only when every side given resolves to the exact requested string as a full sha.

Cache-Control.description: `no-cache`, or `public, max-age=31536000, immutable`

get.description:
Searches the root tree for `README.md` → `README.rst` → `README.txt` →
`README`, matched case-insensitively. Symlinks and binary or over-1 MiB
candidates are skipped. Rendering is the frontend's job.

parameters.name: ref
parameters.description: Branch, tag, or commit sha; HEAD when absent.

200.description: The first usable README. Immutable caching only when `ref` is the resolved full sha (then no `ETag`).

Cache-Control.description: `no-cache`, or `public, max-age=31536000, immutable` for a full sha

get.description:
Tag targets are peeled to the commit, so an annotated tag reports the
commit sha rather than the tag object.

200.description: Branches and tags, each sorted by name

Cache-Control.description: `no-cache`

get.description:
git2 in-process scan across file content, file paths, or commit messages
(docs/DECISIONS.md #26) — not a `git grep` exec or a persistent index.
Every scan is bounded by its own byte/file/commit budget independent of
`limit`; either cap sets `truncated: true`.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description:
Fixed-string, case-insensitive query. Trimmed; empty or over 200
characters is `invalid_param`.

parameters.name: ref
parameters.description: Branch, tag, or commit sha; HEAD when absent.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description:
Parsed manually so an invalid value yields the JSON `invalid_param`
envelope instead of axum's plain-text 400. Never clamped.

200.description: Search results. An empty repository with no `ref` yields an empty result.

Cache-Control.description: `no-cache`, or `public, max-age=31536000, immutable` for a full-sha `ref`

get.description:
Buckets commits into 12 `period`-sized windows anchored on the resolved
commit's authordate (docs/DECISIONS.md #28), plus a per-author breakdown.
git2 in-process scan, same budget approach as search (#26) — not a
persistent index or a `git log` exec.

parameters.name: ref
parameters.description: Branch, tag, or commit sha; HEAD when absent.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description:
Number of authors returned, most active first. Parsed manually so an
invalid value yields the JSON `invalid_param` envelope instead of
axum's plain-text 400. Never clamped.

200.description: Commit statistics. An empty repository with no `ref` yields an empty result.

Cache-Control.description: `no-cache`, or `public, max-age=31536000, immutable` for a full-sha `ref`

get.description:
The `{ref}`/`{path}` boundary is resolved per request by longest-ref
matching (`repo::resolve::resolve_ref_path`), because branch and tag names
may contain `/`; with no match the first segment is taken as the ref.
Omit `{path}` for the root tree.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Directory path; omit (empty) for the root tree

200.description: Directory entries, trees first then by name. Immutable caching only when `{ref}` is the resolved full sha (then no `ETag`).

Cache-Control.description: `no-cache`, or `public, max-age=31536000, immutable` for a full sha

post.summary: Push is SSH-only (CLAUDE.md invariant): every method on this path is 403.

403.description: `read_only` — always; push via SSH instead. Every HTTP method answers the same way.

post.description:
Pipes the request body into `git upload-pack --stateless-rpc` and streams
its stdout back chunked. If upload-pack dies mid-stream the status code
cannot change, so the client sees an early EOF.

requestBody.description: upload-pack negotiation pkt-lines. `Content-Encoding: gzip` is inflated by the server. Limits: 8 MiB compressed, 64 MiB inflated.

200.description: Packfile stream

Cache-Control.description: Always `no-cache`; Smart HTTP never uses `ETag`

400.description: `invalid_param` — gzip inflation failed or the inflated body exceeded 64 MiB

413.description: Compressed body over 8 MiB — axum's `DefaultBodyLimit` answers in plain text, not the JSON envelope

get.description:
Spawns `git upload-pack --stateless-rpc --advertise-refs` and prepends the
pkt-line service header. A `Git-Protocol` request header is sanitized and
forwarded as `GIT_PROTOCOL`, so protocol v2 negotiation works.

parameters.name: service

200.description: pkt-line service header followed by the ref advertisement

Cache-Control.description: Always `no-cache`; Smart HTTP never uses `ETag`

404.description: `repo_not_found` — unknown repository, or a path without the `.git` suffix

commits.description: Total commits by this author within the window.

buckets.description: Parallel to the response's `buckets` — same length and order.

sha.description: Resolved commit sha the file was blamed at.

binary.description: libgit2's NUL heuristic, or content that is not valid UTF-8.

too_large.description: `true` past the same 1 MiB cap the blob endpoint applies.

lines.description: Total line count; 0 for `binary`, `too_large`, or empty files.

ranges.description:
`start_line` ascending, covering the whole file with no gaps.
Empty for `binary`, `too_large`, or empty files.

BlameRange.description: One contiguous run of lines attributed to the same commit (docs/API.md).

sha.description: Sha of the commit the lines are attributed to.

orig_path.description:
Path the lines had in the attributed commit, when the file has since
been renamed — `None` when unchanged (or when the path is not valid
UTF-8). Only whole-file renames are tracked; libgit2 follows them the
same way `git blame` does by default.

sha.description: Resolved commit sha the blob was read from.

mode.description: Octal file mode, e.g. `"100644"` (`"120000"` for symlinks).

size.description: Full size in bytes, regardless of `too_large`.

binary.description: libgit2's NUL heuristic, or content that is not valid UTF-8.

too_large.description: `true` past the 1 MiB inline-content cap; fetch the raw endpoint instead.

content.description:
UTF-8 content; `None` when `binary` or `too_large`. For a symlink this
is the link target path.

target.description: Commit sha of the branch tip.

start.description: Bucket start, UTC, RFC 3339. Ascending order (oldest first).

commits.description: Total commits in this bucket, including any authors cut by `limit`.

CommitAuthor.description:
Commit author of `GET /api/v1/repos/{repo}/commits` (docs/API.md).
The raw email is never exposed; `email_hash` seeds locally generated avatars.

email_hash.description: sha256 hex of the trimmed, lowercased author email.

CommitDetail.description:
Commit detail of `GET /api/v1/repos/{repo}/commits/{sha}` (docs/API.md).
Superset of [`CommitInfo`] so the frontend can extend the log entry type.

sha.description: Full commit sha, even when the request used a branch, tag or short sha.

message.description: Full commit message. `None` for non-utf8 messages.

parent.description: First parent the diff was computed against; `null` for a root commit.

summary.description: First line of the commit message. `None` for non-utf8 commit messages.

next_cursor.description:
Opaque token for the next page; `null` on the last page. Pass it back
verbatim as the `cursor` query parameter.

DiffStatFile.description: Per-file entry shared by the diffstat and the diff (`#[serde(flatten)]`).

additions.description:
Always the full count, even when the file's hunks were truncated.
Binary files report 0.

deletions.description:
Always the full count, even when the file's hunks were truncated.
Binary files report 0.

DiffStatus.description:
How a file changed between the two trees. Rename detection runs with
libgit2 defaults (renames only, 50% similarity).

EntryKind.description: What a tree entry points at, derived from its file mode.

message.description:
Human-readable detail. Internal errors report a generic message; the
cause only goes to the server log.

ErrorResponse.description: Error envelope shared by every failing endpoint (docs/API.md).

truncated.description:
`true` when hunks were dropped past [`MAX_FILE_DIFF_LINES`].
`additions`/`deletions` still count the full change.

FileMatch.description: A file with at least one match (docs/API.md).

lines.description:
Empty for `type=path` matches — the path itself is the match, there is
no line to point at.

content.description: Line content without the trailing newline (lossy utf-8).

text.description: The matching line, truncated to [`MAX_LINE_CHARS`] characters.

LineOrigin.description:
Which side of the diff a line belongs to. Other libgit2 origins (EOF
newline markers and the like) are dropped rather than reported.

ReadmeFormat.description:
How the frontend should render the README. Only `markdown` is converted to
HTML; the rest are shown as plain text (docs/DECISIONS.md #11).

path.description: Actual file name as it appears in the tree (case may differ).

branches.description: Sorted by name ascending; empty for a repository without commits.

RepoInfo.description: Repository list entry as defined by `GET /api/v1/repos` in docs/API.md.

section.description: From the repo config's `[axgit]` section, falling back to `[cgit]`.

owner.description: From the repo config's `[axgit]` section, falling back to `[cgit]`.

description.description: From the repo config's `[axgit]` section, falling back to `[cgit]`.

last_modified.description:
Agefile (`info/web/last-modified`), falling back to the HEAD authordate.
RFC 3339. `None` for empty repositories without an agefile.

RepoSummary.description:
Repository summary as defined by `GET /api/v1/repos/{repo}` in docs/API.md.
Kept separate from [`RepoInfo`] — the list and summary responses are
distinct API contracts.

head.description: HEAD commit sha. `None` for empty repositories (unborn HEAD).

RevDiff.description:
Two-revision diff of `GET /api/v1/repos/{repo}/diff` (docs/API.md). A
plain tree-to-tree comparison (`git diff <from> <to>`), not a merge-base
`...` diff.

from.description:
Resolved full sha of the old side. `null` only when `from` was omitted
and `to` is a root commit (the old side is then the empty tree).

to.description: Resolved full sha of the new side.

diffstat.description: The full, uncapped file list — same rule as the commit diffstat.

SearchKind.description: Requested search variant, echoed back in the response's `type` field.

sha.description:
Resolved commit sha the search ran against. `None` only for an empty
repository (unborn HEAD) with no explicit `ref`.

truncated.description:
`true` when a scan or result budget was hit before the search
finished — the results are a prefix, not necessarily the complete
match set.

commits.description:
`message` results; empty otherwise. Reuses the commit log's shape so
the frontend can render matches the same way as log rows.

StatsPeriod.description: Requested bucket size, echoed back in the response's `period` field.

sha.description:
Resolved commit sha the window is anchored on. `None` only for an
empty repository (unborn HEAD) with no explicit `ref`.

truncated.description:
`true` when the commit scan budget was hit, or the author list was cut
by `limit` — either way, the results are a prefix.

author_count.description:
Number of distinct authors within the window (may exceed
`authors.len()` once cut by `limit`).

authors.description: Sorted by commit count, descending; capped at `limit`.

target.description: Peeled commit sha (not the tag object), so clients can link to the commit.

annotation.description: First line of the tag message. `None` for lightweight tags.

TreeEntryInfo.description: Tree entry of the tree endpoint (docs/API.md).

size.description: Object size in bytes; blobs only, `None` otherwise.

sha.description: Resolved commit sha the listing was taken from.

path.description: Requested directory path; empty string for the root tree.

entries.description: Trees first, then by name ascending.

tags.name: repos
tags.description: Repository discovery, summary, refs, feed, and commit statistics

tags.name: commits

tags.description: Two-revision diff, raw unified diff, and format-patch output

tags.name: files
